::: {#sol-racket-member}

Yes.
The list `(list 'rock 'paper)` is not an element of `beats`,
since rock does not beat paper (@sol-beats-transitive),
so `member` returns `#f`.
When `x` is an element of `L`, `member` returns the part of `L` that starts at `x`, which is not `#f`,
as the second call shows:

```{racket}
#| code-fold: false
(member (list 'rock 'paper) beats)
(member (list 'paper 'rock) beats)
```

:::
